about: Manual receiver-type adjudications for name-resolved call edges that close cycles in callgraph.py's over-approximation. Each rule replaces the targets of calls named `name` inside `caller` with the listed real targets (empty list = the callee is a std/primitive method outside the scanned set). Evidence cites the call line and the receiver's actual type. All paths are relative to P. G4 appends adjudications for the cycles the R-1 repair (generic, trait and chained receivers) closed by name fan-out; each cites the receiver's actual type at NUM HEAD.
